_note: Theme questions used only by the evaluation (spec 007 R9); not part of mt-turn-1.

themes.onboarding: how new users get started: the first-run experience, onboarding steps, the welcome flow and in-app tour, and activation
themes.ds-debt: design system components and tokens: inconsistent or duplicate components and variants, token migration, usage guidelines
themes.research-ops: research operations: the research repository, tagging and finding past studies, recruiting participants, sharing insights
themes.hiring: hiring and team capacity: open roles, interviews, candidates, recruiting designers, headcount
themes.crit-ritual: how the design team works together: crit format, facilitation, meeting rituals, time boxes, feedback norms
themes.roadmap: deciding what to work on: roadmap planning, priorities, trade-offs, requests from other teams
themes.a11y: accessibility of the product: color contrast, screen readers, keyboard access, accessibility audits
